user_saw: ClawRouter rejected uploaded reference images when users tried to edit them with a selected OpenAI image model.
summary: The fix sends uploaded reference images to ClawRouter’s new edit endpoint using the exact selected OpenAI model and a credential with a matching edit grant.
reasoning: The original provider diff added only the generation endpoint and explicitly documented that image edits were unsupported. The path history and fix diff show that this change expands the documented scope by integrating a new, separately granted backend edit route.
